finding.narrative: Kickback shell scheme. Supplier S00004 (Gestoría y Enlace San Nicolás S de RL de CV, RFC EOK870428F5T) was onboarded 2025-03-03 and approved by Diego Zambrano (E00002, Gerente de Compras), who also approved all 8 of its invoices. The supplier's registered address (Av. Universidad 859, Guadalupe, NL) is identical to Zambrano's home address. The supplier billed MXN 575,360 across 8 invoices for generic "servicios de gestión y enlace comercial" — all with round pre-tax amounts (100% round share), none with any goods receipt (0 of 8), and paid in a median of 2 days. Bank flow analysis (CP00002–CP00020) shows the supplier's account (CLABE 127967249590173425) transferred MXN 230,144 — 40% of the invoiced total — directly to Zambrano's personal CLABE (021593586857022021) in 8 transfers between 2025-03-27 and 2025-10-20, none of which returned to the company. This is a classic kickback: company funds paid to a shell controlled by the approving manager, with 40% kicked back to him personally. Scheme total: MXN 575,360 (full amount paid to the shell).

finding.rule: CFF Art. 69-B; LISR Art. 27-I (no estrictamente indispensable); conflict of interest / Ley General de Responsabilidades (private-sector bribery analog, Art. 7 fracc. IX of LFPIORPI where applicable)

finding.narrative: Three invoices from Servicios San Nicolás SAPI de CV (S00017) were each paid twice. The first payment went to the supplier's master CLABE (014273796172575982) and was booked to AP (2100): TX00045 (2025-03-07, 168,977.08, inv 97867B12), TX00497 (2025-11-25, 76,919.60, inv 1EE89A4C), TX00552 (2025-12-29, 238,391.60, inv 13325C31). Each invoice was then paid a second time to an off-master CLABE 002612058920737212 that does not appear on the supplier's master record, and these duplicate payments were booked straight to expense (6000) to conceal them: TX00100 (2025-04-04, 168,977.08), TX00530 (2025-12-19, 76,919.60), TX00612 (2025-12-31, 238,391.60). All three invoices carry valid goods receipts (GR00035, GR00289, GR00312), so the underlying purchases were real; the loss is the diverted duplicate payments totaling MXN 484,288.28. Control failure / possible embezzlement (R4); duplicate deduction under LISR Art. 27.

finding.rule: Control failure / possible embezzlement; LISR Art. 27 (deducción duplicada)

finding.narrative: Round-trip sales scheme between supplier S00021 (Promotora Comercial Chapa SA de CV) and customer C00005 (Comercializadora Hernández SAPI de CV). Three complete loops: (1) Company paid S00021 MXN 348,000 (TX00266, 2025-07-07) for "Promoción y desarrollo de mercado" with no goods receipt; two days later S00021 forwarded MXN 341,040 to C00005 (CP00013, 2025-07-09), and C00005 paid the company MXN 294,000 (TX00279, 2025-07-15) against a fictitious "Fabricación de estructura" sales invoice A1396D49. (2) Same pattern: TX00424 (348,000, 2025-10-08) → CP00018 (341,040, 2025-10-09) → TX00435 (294,000, 2025-10-14) against invoice 991B749E. (3) TX00476 (522,000, 2025-11-10) → CP00022 (511,560, 2025-11-12) → TX00485 (441,000, 2025-11-17) against invoice 54CE20EA. Total MXN 1,218,000 paid out to S00021 and returned as MXN 1,029,000 in fictitious sales from C00005 — a net leakage of MXN 189,000. All three purchase invoices lack goods receipts, were paid in 2-5 days, and were expensed to account 6000 (GL01419/GL01420/GL01421) rather than booked as a genuine service. The sales invoices to C00005 have no PO and no receipts, confirming simulated revenue. This constitutes simulated operations under CFF Art. 69-B/113 Bis and fictitious revenue recognition.

finding.rule: Simulación de operaciones (CFF Art. 69-B / 113 Bis); revenue recognition — fictitious sales

S00020 (Neumática Regiomontana SAPI de CV, RFC COL040206DTB) is on SAT 69-B as "Presunto" (published 2025-07-10): 5 invoices totaling MXN 1,026,600, 100% round amounts, paid via TX00183, TX00269, TX00358, TX00375, TX00434. S00030 (Metálica Santa Catarina SA de CV, RFC IHV020423VE4) is on SAT 69-B as "Definitivo" (published 2025-11-15): 5 invoices totaling MXN 1,044,000, 100% round amounts, paid via TX00022, TX00030, TX00078, TX00189, TX00312. Pattern is consistent with simulated operations / nonexistent services (CFF Art. 69-B, 29-A; LISR Art. 27 improper deductions).
